fns.desc: eap_ttls_process()'s TLS-session-resumption check only validates wpabuf_len(buf) < 1 before reading buf's byte[0] (type), but then unconditionally reads a second byte (pos++; id_len = *pos++;) with no check that the buffer has at least 2 bytes - a session-cache success-data buffer of exactly length 1 causes a 1-byte heap over-read. Currently unreachable in practice because the only writer (eap_ttls_valid_session) always writes >=2 bytes, but the read-side bounds check itself is wrong (should be < 2, not < 1) and offers no real protection if that invariant ever changes.
